narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The digits must add to a multiple of nine, so nine and one works too.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>The digit sum is twenty seven, but the number then ends in one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>An odd number cannot divide by two, so that pair fails.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, put a pair back into the number and divide by eighteen.
<bookmark mark='other'/>Every pair gives an even number whose digits add to a multiple of nine.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu picks eigh nine and b one because the digit sum is a multiple of nine. The number then ends in one, which is odd, so it does not divide by two.
